name: Email Enumeration Prevention
description: Prevents account email/username enumeration via the registration and password-reset forms by normalizing their responses.
project_description:
Provides a easy, configurabile mechanism to prevent email enumeration attack from your site.

 Simply download the module with composer, enable it and configure the feature:

 - Enable or disable prevention on reset password form

 - Set custom message for reset password attempts

 - Enable or disable prevention on register new user form

 - Configure custom email subject and body for user registration attempts with existing emails

 That's it!

 Feel free to submit for enhancements and support the development.
